cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
cards.flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Weight of the Ring
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: Attach to the Ring-bearer. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: At the beginning of each quest phase, either exhaust The One Ring or reveal an additional encounter card this phase.")
cards.flavor: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo... –The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Fear of Discovery
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must either exhaust the Ring-bearer or reveal an additional encounter card. Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 3.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 3.

cards.name: Eaten Alive!
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must deal X damage divided among heroes he controls where X is the number of players in the game. Shadow: Deal 1 damage to defending character.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character.

cards.name: Panicked
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player raises his threat by 3 and passes the first player token to the next player. Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.

cards.name: Overcome by Terror
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must exhaust The One Ring. If The One Ring is already exhausted, the first player must discard 2 cards at random from his hand. Shadow: Defending player discards 1 card at random from his hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 card at random from his hand.

cards.name: Black Steed
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to a Nazgûl enemy in play, if able. (Counts a Mount attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per enemy. Attached enemy gets -10 engagement cost and gains. 'Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, return attached enemy to the staging area.'")

cards.name: The Enemy is Upon Us!
cards.text: When Revealed: Each engaged enemy makes an immediate attack.  If no attack is made this way, The Enemy is Upon Us! gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, remove all progress from the current quest.

cards.name: Rode Like a Gale
cards.text: When Revealed: Return each engaged Nazgûl enemy to the staging area.  If no enemies were returned to the staging area by this effect, Rode Like a Gale gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Ringwraith
cards.text:
Cannot have non-Morgul attachments.
Forced: When Ringwraith attacks, deal it an additional shadow card if The One Ring is exhausted.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Pathless Country
cards.text: Pathless Country gets +4 quest points while in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: After this attack, the attacking enemy engages the next player then makes an immediate attack.

cards.name: The Troll's Camp
cards.text: While The Troll's Camp is the active location, each hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack] +1 [defense].

cards.name: Ford of Bruinen
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects
Response: After Ford of Bruinen leaves play as an explored location, all engaged enemies are discarded.  Travel: The first player must reveal the top card of the encounter deck to travel here.

cards.name: Power In Their Terror
cards.text: When Revealed: Each ally gets -1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Deal 2 damage to each ally with 0 [willpower].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a non-objective attachment you control.

cards.name: Pale Blade
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to a Nazgûl enemy in play, if able. (Counts as a Weapon attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per enemy.  Attached enemy gets +1 [attack] and cannot take non-combat damage.")

cards.name: Fell Rider
cards.text:
Cannot have non-Morgul attachments.
While Fell Rider is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, the first player must either reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1 or engage Fell Rider."

cards.name: Race To Rivendell
cards.back_text: When Revealed: Add Ford of Bruinen and The Witch-king to the staging area.  While at least 1 Nazgûl enemy is in play, Race to Rivendell gets +15 quest points.  Forced: At the end of the round. Reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.  If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

cards.name: An Evil Wound
cards.text:
Attach to the Ring-bearer. Attached hero cannot be healed.
When attached hero would take any amount of damage, reduce the Ring-bearer's life an equal amount instead.  If the Ring-bearer's life reaches zero, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Piercing Cry
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Nazgûl enemy. Either add it to the staging area or put it into play engaged with the first player.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Stricken Dumb
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: You must either shuffle the top card of the burden deck into the encounter deck and reveal an additional encounter card, or raise each player's threat by 3 and immediately end the quest phase (do not resolve the quest).

cards.name: The Nine are Abroad
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Treat the text box of each character in play as blank (except for Traits) until the end of the round.  If there is a Nazgûl enemy in the staging area, The Nine are Abroad gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Pain Assailed Him
cards.text: When Revealed: Reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.  Then, reduce the Ring-bearers [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to 0 until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.

cards.name: Ettenmoors
cards.text: While Ettenmoors is the active location, do not deal Nazgûl enemies a shadow card during the combat phase.  Forced: After any amount of progress is placed on Ettenmoors, reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.

cards.name: The Last Bridge
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects
X is the number of players in the game.  Travel: The first player must reveal the top card of the burden deck and resolve that card as if it were just revealed from the encounter deck to travel here.

cards.name: The Witch-king
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
The Witch-king gets -30 engagement cost while The One Ring is exhausted.  Characters with 1 [willpower] or less cannot defend attacks made by The Witch-king.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer.  Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of the attached hero.  If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: The Old Road
cards.text: Action: Place the top card of the burden deck on the encounter deck to place 4 progress on The Old Road. (Use this action only if you are playing campaign mode.)

cards.name: Pursued by the Enemy
cards.text: Setup: Shuffle each burden card from the Flight to the Ford burden set into a Burden deck. Attach An Evil Wound to the Ring-bearer.  Set Ford of Bruinen and The Witch-King aside, out of play.  Add The Last Bridge and 1 Fell Rider per player to the staging area.  Set the Ring-bearer's life at 15. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: The players cannot advance unless The Last Bridge is in the victory display.  Forced: At the end of the round, reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.
